The '''Karazak system''', in the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]], contained [[Karazak/Legends|Karazak]]. A system with high slaver activity, it was the headquarters of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] and of the [[Slaver Syndicate]].
